record.context_brief: Very weak bounded negativity for smooth curves
record.original_question: Let X be a smooth projective surface in characteristic zero and let g>0. Does there exist a constant b_s(X,g) such that every smooth irreducible curve of geometric genus g on X satisfies C^2 ≥ -b_s(X,g)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.3.5 (Very Weak Bounded Negativity) Let X be a smooth projective surface in characteristic zero and let g > 0 be an integer. There exists a positive constant bs(X, g) bounding the self-intersection of smooth curves of geometric genus g.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth projective surface over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $g > 0$ be an integer. Does there exist a positive constant $b_s(X,g)$, depending only on $X$ and $g$, such that for every smooth irreducible curve $C \subset X$ of geometric genus exactly $g$, the self-intersection number satisfies
$$C^2 \geq -\,b_s(X,g)\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: This "very weak bounded negativity" statement is implied by the Weak Bounded Negativity Conjecture, which asserts a lower bound on self-intersection for reduced curves whose components have geometric genus bounded by g. A complete proof of the weak version (in characteristic zero) was given by X. Hao (arXiv:1708.09463), and further variations have been studied by Ciliberto–Fontanari and others. In particular, the bound for smooth irreducible curves of geometric genus g follows from these results, so the statement is established. (The full Bounded Negativity Conjecture, allowing arbitrary genus, remains open.)

status_evidence.title: Weak Bounded Negativity Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: For any reduced curve C in X with geometric genus of each component bounded above by g, the self-intersection number C^2 is bounded from below.
status_evidence.claim: Hao proves the Weak Bounded Negativity Conjecture in characteristic zero, which implies the very weak version for smooth irreducible curves of fixed geometric genus.

status_evidence.title: Variations on the Weak Bounded Negativity Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Variations on the Weak Bounded Negativity Conjecture (Ciliberto–Fontanari).
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work confirms and extends the weak bounded negativity result.
